instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot at eye-level. Indoors in a living room, an elderly woman in the light purple t-shirt (R1) and an elderly man in the blue t-shirt (R2) sit side-by-side on a green mat. The elderly woman (R1) sits on the left, looking down with a sad, quiet expression. The elderly man (R2) sits on the right, arms crossed over his raised knee, turning his head to look at the woman with concern. Soft natural light fills the room, casting gentle shadows against the background of a sofa and potted plant.
